name: skyDome
notes: Inverted sphere (48x24) follows the camera; gradient from stages[stage].sky with narrow horizon band, sun disc/limb/halo at uKeyDir, soft posterised painterly banding, faint cirrus. depthTest/depthWrite off, z forced to far plane, renderOrder -1000. Below-horizon = uFogFar so the cloud-sea edge is seamless.
